tasks.label: Build LaTeX
args: case "${file}" in *.tex) ;; *) echo "Error: active file is not a .tex file" >&2; exit 1;; esac && mkdir -p /tmp/latex-out ../pdf && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -output-directory=/tmp/latex-out "${file}" && (cd /tmp/latex-out && BIBINPUTS="${fileDirname}:" bibtex "${fileBasenameNoExtension}") && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -output-directory=/tmp/latex-out "${file}" && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -output-directory=/tmp/latex-out "${file}" && cat /tmp/latex-out/"${fileBasenameNoExtension}".pdf > ../pdf/"${fileBasenameNoExtension}".pdf
